title: core.scene — how the parts of a 3D entity are placed and shown, as a versioned record
description: PROPOSED (ruling 5 of 2026-10-13, pending). Profile 3d-entity/1. The manifest's parts[] says where each part sits NOW and is not versioned; nothing in the core said whether a part is shown, how strongly, or in what tint, and nothing kept the placement an earlier save had. Three writers put exactly that into an extension node, and a reader that skips extensions then draws a hidden part, loses a tint and cannot restore an earlier arrangement. This node is the versioned home of that state: one JSON file per version, one entry per part. It carries NO geometry and names parts by part_id only. For the node's ACTIVE version every `transform` here equals the transform of the same part in MANIFEST.json parts[]; where a reader finds them disagreeing the manifest wins for placement and the disagreement is a report entry (the same rule SPEC.md section 3.10 states for a GLB's own node transforms). See spec/SPEC.md section 3.20. Standalone: no $ref to any other file.

space.description: Transforms are parent-relative, exactly as in MANIFEST.json parts[]: the transform of a part is local to its `parent` part, and a root part's is in werk model space.

parts.description: One entry per part this version of the scene describes. A part of MANIFEST.json parts[] that has no entry here is shown, fully opaque, untinted, at the placement parts[] gives - which is also what a package without any core.scene node means.

part_id.description: A part_id of MANIFEST.json parts[]. At most one entry per part.

transform.description: TRS relative to the parent part, never a matrix. Applied in the order scale, then rotation, then translation: p_parent = translation + rotate(rotation, scale * p_local), componentwise scale.

scale.description: dimensionless, [x,y,z]; never zero; a negative component is a reflection along that axis

visible.description: false: the part and every part whose parent chain passes through it are not drawn. The bytes are untouched and every node of the part still loads; this is a statement about display, not about content. A hidden part is said to be hidden HERE - never by a zero scale, which is not a legal scale.

opacity.description: A multiplier on the part's own opacity, 0.0 (fully transparent) to 1.0 (unchanged). Absent means 1.0. It multiplies whatever the payload already says (a material's alpha, a Gaussian's opacity); it is not inherited by child parts.

tint_linear_rgb.description: A multiplier on the part's colour, three numbers [r,g,b], each 0.0 or greater, applied componentwise to LINEAR colour values (after an sRGB payload has been linearised, before any lighting). Absent means [1,1,1]. Not inherited by child parts.

note.description: Optional free text about this arrangement. The reason this VERSION exists is the version's mandatory work note in the manifest, not this field.
